seoTitle: How to Change Link Color in Elementor Easily
metaDescription: Learn how to edit hyperlink color in Elementor, set hover and active states, and use global colors to keep link styling consistent site-wide.
intro: A hyperlink that won't change color or looks inconsistent across pages is usually a sign that Elementor's global color or hover settings need adjusting rather than a bug. This guide covers changing link colors properly, setting hover states, and fixing conflicts caused by your theme.

steps.heading: Change hyperlink color in Elementor
steps.body: Select the text widget or element containing the link and update its color setting from the styling tab.

steps.heading: Edit hover and active color
steps.body: Set a distinct hover color so links visually respond when a visitor moves their cursor over them, improving usability.

steps.heading: Use global colors for consistency
steps.body: Apply Elementor's global color settings so link colors stay consistent across every page rather than being set individually each time.

steps.heading: Fix link color not changing
steps.body: If a color change doesn't apply, check for a theme style overriding Elementor's setting, and clear cache to rule out a stale display issue.

faq.question: Why won't my link color change in Elementor?
faq.answer: This is often caused by the active WordPress theme applying its own link styling that overrides Elementor's setting, or by cached CSS still showing the old color.

faq.question: How do I set a different color for link hover state?
faq.answer: In Elementor's link or text styling options, look for a separate hover color field distinct from the normal state color.

faq.question: What are global colors in Elementor?
faq.answer: Global colors are predefined color swatches you can apply across your site so changing one updates it everywhere it's used, keeping styling consistent.

faq.question: Does this work the same in Elementor free and Pro?
faq.answer: Basic link color and hover styling is available in Elementor's free version, though Pro may offer more advanced global styling controls.
